set -e
trap 'echo 1017600 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_min_freq
echo 4320000 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_max_freq

echo 1017600 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_min_freq
echo 1401600 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_max_freq

cd /data/local/tmp/dense-af-decode-diagnostic
env LD_LIBRARY_PATH=. ADSP_LIBRARY_PATH=. GGML_HEXAGON_DEVICES=1 GGML_HEXAGON_PROFILE=1 GGML_HEXAGON_TIMING=1 GGML_HEXAGON_POWER=nom GGML_HEXAGON_DCVS=0 timeout 240 taskset c0 ./dense-af-decode -m /data/local/tmp/models/Qwen2.5-3B-2K/ggml/weights.gguf --placement mixed --output mixed-measure --prompt 256 --steps 8
cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_min_freq /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_max_freq /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/scaling_cur_freq
